title: File access built from input (erlang) — review required
description: A erlang file operation builds its path from input: read_files*([^)]*++. Traversal sequences escape the directory. This lexical rule flags the construction; the reviewer confirms confinement via filename prefix check.
remediation: Confine with filename prefix check or map input through an allowlist.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any input-built path matches.
